observations.body: Men’s prayer and women’s learning receive gathered instructions. I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting. but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

payload.posture: Read 1 Timothy 2:8–15 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states men’s prayer and women’s learning receive gathered instructions. I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting. but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
